scientific_limitations_and_integrity.claim_scope: Finite three-position supports and their forest-support infinite extensions; no general larger-support classification.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.historical_priority: The classical Fine-Wilf connectivity result and the published incidence-forest characterization are prior; the exact three-support transfer may have an unindexed predecessor.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.labeling: Sparse-symbol support is designated explicitly; arbitrary binary relabeling is outside the necessity statement.
